    Morning briefing

Expected shape: a straight session over the remaining 184.2 minutes, a stated expectation and not a certainty; the Evening Court can score it against SPY's path from 757.95, and a large swing away and back before the close proves me wrong.

    WHERE CONVICTION SITS: thin, and in fewer bets than the twenty lines suggest. WMT, COST, MCD and HD, with CRH beside them, are ONE up-tape consumer and defensive bet at rsi 72.7 to 77.3, and they rank as one: WMT carries the room's highest number on only five votes, MCD at 63 on eight is the firmer expression. GOOG, GOOGL, META and RDDT are one beaten-down internet rebound, and GOOG with GOOGL is one Alphabet bet in two columns. MRVL, CIEN and DELL are one hardware short, and the MU call sits against them without hedging them. TSLA and REGN stand alone at the head of the share column. Correlation in this book is not diversification, and none of it has a record that earns a size. LEADER: the Dagger (equity 101,212.39, lead 184.82; no extra weight, R33). It diverges from the room most on GOOG (21 against 62), GOOGL (28 against 47.5) and RDDT (26 against 49), and agrees on TSLA (74 against 70). CALIBRATION moves no shipped number: only Graham +0.085 and Oracle +0.025 are positive, all figures are small, and my own G_OPTION sits at the room's median rounded to the integer R77 asks. The block lists blackswan, domestic_desk and skeptic beside the weights, and the re-serve reads all three NON-FILING in the share column over these lines. The SHADOW lesson on calibration is shown, not applied. THE MODEL disagrees sharply on lines I ship: RDDT +20.11 against Sam and Croupier, RCL +4.12 and COIN +1.07 and MRVL +2.40 against my shorts; REGN +8.72, MAR +5.67 and COST +5.04 agree with the direction, and CIEN -7.04 agrees with the put.

    WHAT INVALIDATES THE DAY: the up-tape bet fails if WMT, COST, MCD and HD close down together at or through their kills (121.45, 1001.10, 253.05, 322.56); the head of the share column fails on a close below 378.46 on TSLA or below 909.34 on REGN; the hardware short fails on a close above 215.16 on MRVL. Each lead's own one-sentence kill line binds, and no headline or data print does. HORIZONS: 5 intraday, 26 swing and 9 position across the 40 leads; on the book, AMZN and F intraday, GOOG, MCD, HD and RDDT position, and the other fourteen swing. No candidate earned long-term on what is served. HOUSE RULES, decided before the session and not revisited inside it: (1) STAKES - share lines flat at 1.0 (R81); option legs at 1.0, with MU at 0.5 under R4-OVERFLOW as the desk writes it, and no chair override anywhere (R129(a)). That is 9.5 option units beside 10.0 share units, and no add on any losing line and no re-sizing. (2) EXITS - each share line exits on its close-basis kill or at its stated horizon, whichever comes first, so AMZN closes at today's close. Each option leg follows its EXIT line: ratchet at its break-even, kill on the underlying's close, else close on 2026-11-05 for RCL, 2026-11-12 for GOOGL, F, COIN, META and MU, and 2026-11-19 for MAR, RDDT, CIEN and DELL. At the stand-in delta 0.5 (no delta served; it is wrong for in-the-money legs) GOOGL, RDDT, CIEN, DELL, COIN, RCL, META and MU spend the whole premium before the kill, so the premium is the real stop; F keeps 0.26 of 0.61 and MAR 16.74 of 27.32. Kills on three or more of WMT, COST, MCD, HD and CRH at one close are read as one up-tape bet failing, not as separate bad draws. (3) WINDFALL - when a leg's served mark rises to 2 x its premium at a freeze, half is banked at that mark and the record is written before the next freeze (R148); the other half rides to its own exit. No held contract's freeze mark is served this morning, so held claims read WINDFALL STATE UNWRITTEN, and the R155(b) nightly writer and the next court settle them; nothing is filled retroactively.
